tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Search long-form podcast and conference episodes (AI, investing, crypto, startups, macro) by keyword, person, topic or date. Returns each match's title, people, date, topics, editorial summary, matching chapters and links to the full Markdown text and YouTube. Use `person` to answer 'which podcasts

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: List hosts and guests in the library with episode counts and latest appearance date, most frequent first. Filter with a partial name.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List all topics and series (names are Chinese, e.g. 人工智能 = AI, 投资 = investing, 加密与 Web3 = crypto) with episode counts.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get one episode by id: titles, summaries and full chapter list (with page anchors and YouTube timestamps) for each available language, plus links to the full text as Markdown and paragraph-level JSONL.
